text: Kubernetes (K8s) is an open-source container orchestration platform that automates deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications across clusters of machines.
FinOps is the practice of bringing financial accountability to cloud spending, combining finance, engineering, and operations to optimize cost and usage.
Observability in software systems rests on three pillars: metrics, logs, and traces, enabling teams to understand system behavior in production.
LLMOps applies MLOps principles to large language model applications: prompt management, evaluation, tracing, and cost control.
The CAP theorem states that a distributed system can provide at most two of three guarantees: consistency, availability, and partition tolerance.
